verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms docs.customer.io/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a structured index. The docs also expose llms-full.txt, section-level llms.txt files (ai, messaging, accounts) and markdown versions of pages (e.g. sdk.md, transactional/api.md), plus a machine-readable openapi.json, so an agent can be pointed directly at agent-oriented docs. Missing for 10: independent or community reports of agents actually consuming these files, and first-party guidance on how to use llms.txt with an agent.
